name: Soyuz TMA-9
about: Soyuz TMA-9 (2006-040A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMA), launched 2006 Sep 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2006 Sep 20), held fixed
docked to S26400; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q591584), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory

events.why: landing day from Wikidata; the hour is not given
